# Swift-era compatibility fixtures (frozen)

These files were generated by the 0.x Swift app (MacVPN 0.4.0, its real `ConnectionStore`,
`ConnectionRankingStore`, `SystemOTPStore` and `PropertyListSerialization`), except the hand-written `inputs/`.
They prove that the Rust code reads (and writes back byte for byte) what the Swift app wrote, which the migration
still depends on.

They are frozen: the Swift sources and the generator are no longer in the tree (they are in the git history, up to
tag `v0.4.0` and the commit before the legacy Swift code was removed). Do not edit or regenerate them.
